facts.F1: Bug 6656: Custom Cycle Time measure not filtering items in scatterplot. With a custom Cycle Time measure (end state Ready for Release), the scatterplot shows exactly the same items as the default Cycle Time (including items Done, In Production, Complete, Cancelled); only the values are recalculated. Expected (reporter): the scatterplot shows all items that have reached Ready for Release, each measured from entering Analysis to reaching Ready for Release, including items that later moved to In Production or Done; items that have not yet reached Ready for Release do not appear as data points.
facts.F10: Render the Cycle Time scatterplot with default data (items A closed 20 Nov, C closed 3 Nov) and select the named measure Analysis -> Ready for Release whose fetch returns A (end 5 Nov) and B (not closed, end 12 Nov); also a fetch still pending, and a fetch that fails; click a dot.
